annotations.title: Get the organization behind this WhatsApp connection

description:
Get the name and photo of the organization whose WhatsApp numbers this connection uses.

Use it to know which WhatsApp account you are acting on, for example
when more than one organization is connected. `name` is the
organization name and `picture` the address of its photo, present only
when it has one. `id` stays the same when the same account is connected
again. It says nothing about the numbers themselves: `list_numbers`
does that.
name: get_profile

outputSchema.description: The profile as the host receives it. No other property is allowed.
outputSchema.title: ConnectionProfile
